## About
Autobahn Service Center is an owner-operated repair shop on Regal Road in Plano, serving drivers across Dallas and Collin County. We work on Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche, Jaguar, Range Rover, Audi, Volkswagen, Volvo, Lexus, Infiniti and other imported cars.
Our staff are factory trained, and we use state-of-the-art diagnostic scanners to track down mechanical and electrical problems. You get a full diagnosis and a detailed estimate before the work starts.
We have built our name on quality work, reasonable prices and honest service. One reviewer said Farnoosh, our manager, made them feel treated as a person, not just another customer.

## Services
- Factory scheduled maintenance: Complete factory scheduled maintenance for European and luxury cars, including Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Jaguar, Porsche, Audi, Volkswagen, Range Rover, Volvo and Lexus.
- Diagnostics: State-of-the-art diagnostic equipment for the makes and models we service, so we can find the problem quickly and accurately.
- Mechanical and electrical repair: Batteries, alternators, starters, lights and wiring, along with drive train, cooling, fuel, exhaust, steering and suspension work.
- Brake jobs and oil changes: One reviewer mentioned our team handling brake jobs, oil changes and performance parts to a high standard.
- Vehicle inspection before purchasing: One reviewer had us inspect a car before buying it from a dealer and said it helped them make an informed decision.

## FAQ
Q: What cars do you work on?
A: We specialize in imported cars, including Mercedes-Benz, BMW, Porsche, Jaguar, Range Rover, Audi, Volvo, Lexus and Infiniti.

Q: What are your hours?
A: We are open Monday through Friday, 7:30 a.m. to 6:00 p.m.

Q: Where are you located?
A: We're at 2812 Regal Road in Plano, just east of Independence Parkway.

Q: What if I don't see the service I need?
A: Give us a call at (972) 599-0999 and we'll talk through your situation and the best way to handle it.

Q: Do you take credit cards?
A: Yes, we accept all major cards.

- "10/10 service, highly recommend you go here for car service.

Context: Farnoosh was my advisor, and Owen was my tech. This was the first time I brought my vehicle into Autobahn Service Center. My car has been having issues lately — the engine wires had been chewed through by rodents, a problem I got fixed less than a week prior to this incident. Just yesterday, my battery, and free scans from O’Riley and AutoZone were saying the issue was the Alternator. I dropped off my car at Autobahn using their overnight ticket drop off since it was after hours. They contacted me first thing (~8 AM) in the morning and said they would get to testing the battery and electrical system. Farnoosh was so kind and understanding, giving me a 25% first-time customer discount on the check.

Around 12:40 pm that same day, Farnoosh got back to me and let me know the battery was the issue, not the alternator. He encouraged me to go back to where I got the battery done 11 months prior and get it replaced under warranty. I picked up my vehicle, and he graciously waived the cost of the service. I can’t express how thankful I am for this kind gesture as car issues have plagued me all this month. This small act will mean that the next time I need any car service, Autobahn is the first place I will be going. They have made a customer for life.

To top it all off, he gave me free advice on what anti-rodent spray to buy to prevent any wire tampering by vermin in the future. Thank you so much for helping me out in a tough time, and everyone should see if Autobahn Service Center can help you the next time you want to service your vehicle." (Chad Nail, 5/5)
